name: Caster of the Conjurer’s Gauntlet
body:
Your summoned creatures helped you pass the Conjurer’s Gauntlet at the Diamond Academy.

Prerequisite: Diamond Academy Graduate trait, caster level 2nd

Benefit: Each creature you conjure with any summon spell gains a +1 enhancement bonus to hit and a +1 enhancement bonus to the DC of its spells and spell-like abilities.
